title: Blistered Green Peppers with Salt
summary: A simple Spanish-style tapa of green peppers cooked until blistered and lightly smoky, then finished with salt. Best served hot from the pan as a quick snack.
steps: Wash and dry the peppers well.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add the peppers in a single layer and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the skins are blistered and charred in spots and the peppers have softened.
Transfer the peppers to a plate, sprinkle with the salt, and serve hot.
